background_image_description: Soft, large-scale airbrushed gradient filling the 1600x1600 canvas: warm ivory (#F7F3E6) in the top-left and bottom-left corners blending smoothly into vivid sky blue (#2E72C8) across the right-center, with deeper cobalt-blue core (#1F5EAE) and a pale misty light in the bottom-right transitioning back toward off‑white (#EEF3F2). Edges are vignetted and feathered; no hard shapes or texture.

nodes.svg_description: Single thin, translucent white elliptical stroke (no fill) tilted about 15 degrees counterclockwise, loosely encircling the two text lines; accompanied by three small four-point sparkle stars (diamond-tipped cross with short arms) in solid white: one above-left of the first line, one small sparkle just below-right of the ellipse center, and one larger sparkle below-right near the end of the second line.
